verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing documents the building blocks for this. You can create virtual cards via the paymentInstrument API. Transaction rules can automatically decline authorizations that don't meet business requirements. Relayed authorisation gives your server a real-time approve/decline decision on every transaction, and cards can be permanently closed. Together these let a developer approximate a single-use, merchant-locked, exact-amount card, but only through custom logic and orchestration rather than a native card type. Missing for 10: a native single-use card type, documented merchant-lock and exact-amount rule types, automatic card invalidation after the first use, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
